categories.description: Patient identifying information including name, DOB, address, contact, and MRN.
Known allergies, reactions, and severity information.
Current and past medications with dosage, frequency, route, pharmacy, refill status, and indication. Extract from both structured lists and narrative text.
categories.extraction_notes: Extract from medication lists, refill requests, and pharmacy narratives. Include all available context.

categories.description: Medical conditions, ICD codes, onset dates, and status.
Surgical and medical procedures with CPT codes and dates.
Laboratory test results with values, units, reference ranges, abnormal flags, and panel groupings. Extract ALL rows from lab tables.
categories.extraction_notes: Create ONE entity per test result. Include abnormal flags (H, L, A) and panel names (Lipid Panel, BMP, LFT, CBC). Extract complete multi-row tables.

categories.description: Blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, SpO2, weight, height, BMI.

Tobacco use, alcohol use, occupation, living situation, and social determinants of health (SDOH) screenings including financial strain, food security, transportation, housing, and mental health screenings.
categories.extraction_notes: Extract ALL questionnaire-style screening data. Group by category: tobacco_use, alcohol_use, sdoh_screening, mental_health_screening. Include PHQ-9 and other mental health scores.

categories.description: Provider notes, assessment, plan, and recommendations.
Document type, date, author/provider, and facility.
Patient visits, appointments, and encounters including office visits, telemedicine, departments, providers, addresses, and dates.
Healthcare providers involved in patient care including PCP, specialists, nurses, and their roles.
